experienceHighlights.text: Candidate runs quarterly business reviews for twenty-two mid-market accounts under the team's review format.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in running quarterly business reviews, presenting to customer executives, tracking adoption, coordinating renewals, and documenting open items.
